article:
Test 18
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Jacob Harvey
Lead singer with the band Mason
Fans always ask how Mason started. My guitar teacher knew I wanted to be in a band and said putting posters up at school to find musicians could help. The trouble was, I knew my classmates weren’t into rock, like me. In the end, I heard about a band who’d recently stopped playing. The singer had moved away, so they couldn’t practise. I messaged the drummer and the keyboard player. We did some songs together, and we’ve been together ever since. We’ve become close mates: me singing, Kath on drums and Victor on keyboards.
That was eight years ago. Our audiences have increased, and we play in bigger places. We still do concerts in our home town, though, on every tour – that’s important to us. I still get nervous before a concert, but once I’m on stage I feel fine. Sometimes things go wrong, but that’s OK! And being in front of an audience improves our performance. The atmosphere’s incredible, with everyone videoing their favourite songs on their phones!
We’ve recently met Gary Keen from rock band The 45s. He took us round his studio and let us record our song Days there! He stayed to listen and made some interesting suggestions. He even promised to take a copy to a meeting he was having with an international music company! And he’s put a link to us on his social media. More than anything, that’s what’s got even more people talking about us, and it’s what really changes things.
People sometimes want advice about being in a band. Well, when you get more well-known, people start offering to manage you. Don’t do anything you don’t want to do; don’t worry about doing things yourself; it’s better than being with the wrong person. You need to get your music heard, though. Giving away tickets to shows is a good way to do this. Just remember to develop your own style and be original. And maybe one day, you’ll get recognised in the street! The first time that happened was amazing! And we’re very happy to be in photos and chat with people. We’re nothing without our fans, after all!

questions.text: How did Jacob find people for his band?

options.label: A
options.text: He invited musicians from another band to play with him.

options.label: B
options.text: His teacher suggested a band to join.

options.label: C
options.text: He put a notice up on his school noticeboard.

options.label: D
options.text: He chose musicians who were already his friends.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jacob 组建乐队的方式是 “heard about a band who’d recently stopped playing... messaged the drummer and the keyboard player. We did some songs together”（邀请另一支乐队的乐手），对应 A 选项 “邀请另一支乐队的乐手一起演奏”。

questions.text: What does Jacob say about playing music to an audience?

options.label: A
options.text: Going on stage gets easier each time.

options.label: B
options.text: Making mistakes is very embarrassing.

options.label: C
options.text: Doing a live show makes the band play better.

options.label: D
options.text: Seeing people recording the songs is annoying.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jacob 提到观众表演时，“being in front of an audience improves our performance”（现场表演让乐队表现更好），对应 C 选项 “现场表演使乐队演奏更好”。

questions.text: What did Jacob find most useful about meeting a famous musician?

options.label: A
options.text: Gary included some information about the band online.

options.label: B
options.text: Gary introduced Jacob to a new contact in the music business.

options.label: C
options.text: Jacob got help to finish writing a song.

options.label: D
options.text: Gary let them use his music studio.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jacob 认为遇见著名音乐人最有用的是 “he’s put a link to us on his social media. More than anything, that’s what’s got even more people talking about us”（Gary 在社交媒体上分享乐队链接），对应 A 选项 “Gary 在网上包含了乐队信息”。

questions.text: Jacob’s advice to other young bands is to

options.label: A
options.text: create a website to advertise yourselves.

options.label: B
options.text: let people see you play for free.

options.label: C
options.text: get a manager as soon as you can.

options.label: D
options.text: follow the latest trends in music.

questions.explanation: 解析：Jacob 给年轻乐队的建议是 “Giving away tickets to shows is a good way to do this”（免费赠送演出门票），对应 B 选项 “让人们免费看演出”。

questions.text: What would fans of Mason say about the band?

options.label: A
options.text: I love that all the members have great voices – it’s good that they all have a chance to sing, not just Jacob!

options.label: B
options.text: I live in the band’s home town. I wish they’d play here when they’re on tour – they stopped doing that as soon as they got famous!

options.label: C
options.text: Days is my favourite song – I loved that the lead singer of The 45s sang on it too!

options.label: D
options.text: The fact that Mason are always willing to talk to their fans is great. It shows they think we’re important to them.

questions.explanation: 解析：D 选项 “Mason 乐队总是愿意和粉丝交谈，这很棒。表明他们认为我们对他们很重要” 与原文 “we’re nothing without our fans” 一致。
